cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Can not copy when `Ctrl+Shift+C` is pressed in Vi mode
cases.description:
### System

OS: Windows
Version: alacritty 0.13.0-rc1 (ada35ae)

### Issue

When I switch to Vi mode in Alacritty 0.13.0-rc1, press `v` to select a portion of text, and then press `Ctrl+Shift+C`, the selected text **cannot** be copied to the clipboard.

And if I set key bindings in `alacritty.toml` as follows, I can copy the selected text successfully in Vi mode:

```
[keyboard]
bindings = [
    { key = "C", mods = "Control|Shift", action = "Copy" },
    { key = "C", mods = "Control|Shift", mode = "Vi|~Search", action = "ClearSelection" },
]
```

This problem did not occur in version 0.12.3, but it first appeared in version 0.13.0-rc1

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix the order of `ClearSelection` in Vi mode
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix the order of `ClearSelection` in Vi mode

Fixes #7438.

--

Maybe we should do that without a binding instead, e.g. when copying from inside the Vi mode, so it's not config order dependent and consistent with user added bindings.
